sources.entry: Sourcegraph Cody - AI coding assistant with deep codebase context, for VS Code, JetBrains and web. #freemium

summary.name: Cody
summary.one_liner: Cody is Sourcegraph's AI coding assistant that uses LLMs and codebase context from Sourcegraph's Search API to help developers understand, write, and fix code.
use_cases: generate and edit code in an IDE
automate common dev tasks with shared prompts
summary.what_it_does:
Cody is an AI coding assistant that answers questions, generates code, and edits code using LLMs plus context from local and remote codebases. It pulls context through Sourcegraph's Search API, so it can draw on APIs, symbols, and usage patterns across a whole codebase. Developers can chat with Cody, use @ to add specific files, symbols, or repositories as context, and get code completions and auto-edit suggestions based on cursor movement. Premade and customizable prompts can be saved and shared with a team, and Context Filters can exclude selected repositories from chat and autocomplete.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
notable: Pulls codebase context via Sourcegraph's Search API across local and remote repositories
Auto-edit proposes changes based on cursor movements and recent typing
Context Filters to exclude repositories from chat and autocomplete
caveats: Page says it is supported on Sourcegraph Enterprise; Enterprise access requires contacting the team
Visual Studio extension is marked Experimental
Pricing is not stated on the page
